te zullen inloggen
in te zullen loggen

glosses: Verbinding bewerken met een centrale computer via modem of toetsenbord op afstand

examples.text: Dat inloggen was zo gepiept. Helaas betrof het een ingelogde vandaal.

glosses: To gain access to a computer system, usually by providing a previously registered username and password.

examples.text: I would like to log in to check my e-mail, but I can't remember my password.

glosses: To be placed at a certain ranking.

examples.text: Their cover version of Bobby "Blue" Bland's "Turn On Your Love Light" logged in at number 80 in 1968.
